       Notes:

Patient: Rachel Johnson (Mrs.)

Ht: 154 cm
Wt: 65 kg
BMI: 27.42(10/04/2018)

Divorced, no children, lives alone at home.
Non-smoker
Chronic Alcoholic (since 2000) 2-3 drinks per day.

Father: Parkinsonism, Hypertension
Maternal grandmother - died Colorectal Cancer, 76 yrs
Maternal grandfather-died Heart Attack

Paternal grandfather-unknown

1950 Typhoid fever

simvastatin. Review after one week.

bath to resolve the pain.

10/04/2018 Severe pain continues, high level of alcohol consumption to get
